title: Capability-use event payload v0.2 (0ds M1 v1 thin registry)
description: 0ds M1 v1 (2026-10-28, 366 charter §1 item 4): one mechanical capability-registry decision for a tool call. The row contains the tool name, mechanical rights label, grant/deny decision, optional stable reason and optional session preopen root. It never contains raw tool arguments, file contents, tokens or other secret material; permission policy remains the separate policy gate.

tool.description: Tool name as declared to the model.

rights.description: Mechanical risk-class label; not a permission-policy grant.

reason.description: Stable audit key; no free-form error text.

preopen_root.description: Session preopen root label; omitted when the registry has no session root.
